key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the BenthicBloom icon in the top panel.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Print verbose debug information to the GNOME Shell log (journalctl).

key.name: wallpaper-folders
key.description: List of folder paths scanned for wallpaper images.

key.name: apply-to-lock-screen
key.description: Whether the rotated wallpaper is also applied to the lock screen background.

key.name: rotation-enabled
key.description: Whether wallpapers are automatically rotated on a timer.

key.name: rotation-interval-seconds
key.description: Number of seconds between automatic wallpaper changes.

key.name: rotation-mode
key.description: Whether wallpapers are shown sequentially or in random (shuffle) order.

key.name: current-index
key.description: Internal state tracking the currently displayed wallpaper in sequential mode.

key.name: transition-enabled
key.description: Whether wallpaper changes fade smoothly instead of switching instantly.

key.name: transition-duration-ms
key.description: Duration, in milliseconds, of the crossfade animation between wallpapers.

key.name: live-wallpaper-enabled
key.description: Whether a video is played as an animated desktop background instead of a static image.

key.name: live-wallpaper-path
key.description: Path to the video file used as the live wallpaper.

key.name: live-wallpaper-muted
key.description: Whether audio playback is muted for the live wallpaper video.

key.name: live-wallpaper-playback-rate
key.description: Playback rate multiplier applied to the live wallpaper video.

key.name: live-wallpaper-pause-on-battery
key.description: Automatically pause video playback while the system is unplugged to save power.

key.name: live-wallpaper-pause-when-fullscreen
key.summary: Pause live wallpaper when a window is fullscreen
key.description: Automatically pause video playback while a window is fullscreen, since it would be hidden anyway.

key.name: oled-protection-enabled
key.description: Master switch for all OLED burn-in protection features.

key.name: oled-pixel-shift-enabled
key.description: Periodically nudge the rendered background by a few pixels to avoid static burn-in.

key.name: oled-pixel-shift-interval-seconds
key.description: Number of seconds between each pixel-shift step.

key.name: oled-pixel-shift-amount-px
key.description: Maximum distance, in pixels, the background is offset during pixel shifting.

key.name: oled-dim-on-idle-enabled
key.description: Reduce background brightness after the system has been idle for a while.

key.name: oled-dim-idle-delay-seconds
key.description: Number of seconds of inactivity before the background is dimmed.

key.name: oled-dim-brightness
key.description: Brightness multiplier applied to the background while dimmed (0 = black, 1 = full brightness).

key.name: oled-force-rotation-enabled
key.description: Force a wallpaper change after the maximum static duration even if automatic rotation is otherwise disabled.

key.name: oled-max-static-duration-seconds
key.description: Maximum number of seconds a single wallpaper may remain on screen before OLED protection forces a change.
